purpose: Non-executable planning specification for resolving one selected GMI layer into canonical Validator 2.0 field evidence.

evidenceBaseline.acceptedDomainDecision: Direct Tema is preferred; delivered S_FCODE is an accepted GMI fallback when direct Tema has no usable object value.

schemaKeySourcePrecedence: union of own enumerable feature.attributes keys within the same selected layer and geometry
SCHEMA_UNAVAILABLE when neither source can establish a schema
steps: Require explicit layerId, exact owned dataset, and sourceFormat gmi.
Enumerate only point and line schema keys inside that dataset.
For each canonical field and applicable geometry, collect exact direct, unique case-only, accepted fallback, and recognized unsupported candidates.
Preserve every literal candidate and assign mapping kind, source kind, authority, and confidence.

Return BOUND for one accepted candidate, MULTIPLE_ACCEPTED for coexisting accepted candidates, FIELD_ABSENT when schema evidence is available but no candidate exists, UNRESOLVED_SOURCE when only recognized unsupported candidates exist, and SCHEMA_UNAVAILABLE when absence cannot be established.
Do not inspect values during schema binding and do not inspect another layer.

caseNormalizationPolicy.comparisonTransform: Unicode NFC followed by Unicode default uppercase, used for key comparison only
caseNormalizationPolicy.multipleAcceptedKeys: Retain all candidates. Object-level strict field equivalence may resolve equal values; unequal values or undefined equivalence produce conflict.

objectValuePolicy.whitespaceOnlyHandling: Preserve as VALUE_PRESENT with a WHITESPACE_ONLY lexical flag. A field-specific consumer may later reject it; the adapter does not globally trim it.
objectValuePolicy.sourceValue: Exact value received from feature.attributes, without adapter coercion.
objectValuePolicy.sourceLexeme: UNAVAILABLE when the current GMI parser has already coerced the original text.
objectValuePolicy.normalizedValue: Absent by default; only later field-specific normalization may add one.
objectValuePolicy.defaultEquivalence: Strict same JavaScript primitive type and value; no parseFloat, no universal stringification, no numeric tolerance.

precedence: Tema exact or unique case-only form
S_FCODE exact or unique case-only form
objectLevelRules: A usable direct Tema value resolves identity and remains preferred.
When direct Tema has no usable object value, a usable delivered S_FCODE value resolves identity as ACCEPTED_FALLBACK.
When both values are usable and strictly equal under the Tema code equivalence policy, resolve Tema and retain both provenance records.
When both values are usable and disagree, return CONFLICT and expose both candidates without choosing.
When neither accepted value is usable and only unsupported candidates exist, return UNRESOLVED_SOURCE.
When no accepted or unsupported candidate supplies a usable value, return MISSING.
temaResolutionPolicy.temaCodeEquivalence: Compare non-empty primitive code values as exact strings after no transformation beyond the parser's already supplied representation; preserve both source values. No numeric equivalence.

fields.dataset: exact parsed dataset owned by layerId

fields.candidates: all matching accepted and unsupported schema candidates
fields.conflicts: schema ambiguity details only; no object values

fields.sourceIndex: index inside this exact layer dataset only
fields.localIdentity: prefer guid, then parser id, then sourceIndex

rules: Never use a bare array index as global identity.
Never search another layer when dereference fails.
Always include layerId and geometryType in key.
Index is only an in-run fallback inside the exact datasetRevision.
No ObjectFieldValue may exist without an already constructed, layer-qualified ObjectRef.
The ObjectRef layerId and datasetRevision must match the precomputed LayerFieldBinding ownership context.
Extraction must not construct a cross-layer identity or borrow a binding or value from another layer.

fields.objectValueResolver: conceptual pure resolver over this exact layer result

consumerBoundaries.temaGate: Validation consumes Tema identity state. MISSING leads to one missing-Tema issue; CONFLICT leads to an identity-conflict path; downstream object-specific rules skip unless identity is RESOLVED.
consumerBoundaries.rules: Requiredness, allowed values, applicability, severity, and issue generation are not adapter responsibilities.
consumerBoundaries.ui: The adapter exposes FIELD_ABSENT separately from VALUE_MISSING so a future table can synthesize missing required columns without inventing source fields.

formatBoundary.gmi: This specification targets delivered GMI properties and full source-oriented evidence.
formatBoundary.sosi: A separate adapter may use the same canonical IDs. Current parser-derived S_FCODE must be DERIVED and validationAuthoritative false; no SOSI mappings are defined here.
formatBoundary.kof: A separate limited adapter is required. Synthetic KOF S_FCODE is not delivered Tema evidence; no KOF mappings are defined here.

implementationSequence.title: Contracts and registry guards
implementationSequence.scope: Define non-UI contracts, enums, registry uniqueness, and one-layer input guards.

implementationSequence.title: 41-field direct layer binding
implementationSequence.scope: Bind exact and unique case-only GMI schema keys once per geometry.

implementationSequence.title: Tema and S_FCODE identity resolution
implementationSequence.scope: Add direct/fallback precedence, provenance, missing, conflict, and unresolved-source states.

implementationSequence.title: ObjectRef and layer isolation
implementationSequence.scope: Require layerId, enforce datasetRevision ownership/staleness guards, establish stable local identity, allow sourceIndex only as a layer-local fallback, and prohibit cross-layer identity or borrowing.

implementationSequence.title: Per-object canonical value extraction
implementationSequence.scope: Require an already constructed ObjectRef, consume precomputed LayerFieldBinding, distinguish FIELD_ABSENT, VALUE_MISSING, and VALUE_PRESENT, and perform no generic coercion.

implementationSequence.title: Synthetic adapter tests
implementationSequence.scope: Implement the documented vectors, including all rejected suffix and alias families.

implementationSequence.title: V2 engine foundation integration
implementationSequence.scope: Expose resolved evidence to classification/rules without importing legacy code or changing legacy behavior.

legacyMigrationStatement: The legacy validator, fields.json, fieldValidation.js, validator.js, parsers, and validation UI remain frozen. This specification does not authorize any production patch or runtime import.
